tools.name: Cube_SetSpeed
tools.description: Set the cube rotation speed in degrees per second

tools.name: Cube_RandomColor
tools.description: Change the color of the cube to a random color

tools.name: Cube_DecreaseOpacity
tools.description: Decrease the opacity of the cube (make it more transparent / see-through)

amount.description: Optional amount to decrease opacity by (0.0 to 1.0, default is 0.25)

tools.name: Cube_IncreaseOpacity
tools.description: Increase the opacity of the cube (make it more solid / opaque)

amount.description: Optional amount to increase opacity by (0.0 to 1.0, default is 0.25)

tools.name: Cube_SetOpacity
tools.description: Set the cube opacity to a specific value between 0.0 (transparent) and 1.0 (opaque)

opacity.description: Target opacity from 0.0 (transparent) to 1.0 (fully opaque), or percentage 0 to 100
